results.title: Industry has to follow the consumer, says FSSAI chief on food-safety push
results.description: The FSSAI is expanding its scrutiny of food businesses, with a focus on e-commerce, labelling and food safety in schools.

results.title: Tourism Governance... Is the Crown Prince's Message in His Remarks to the Cabinet
results.description: The issue of tourism today is no longer just about how we attract tourists to Jordan, but about how we manage the entire tourism system, and how we ensure that growth in visitor numbers translates into sustainable economic growth whose impact benefits the state, the investor, and the local community.
results.source: Jordan News | Latest News From Jordan, Mena
